evidence_class: prospective locally designed software benchmark; paper-population replication plus a novel-mechanism holdout within the same researcher-designed simulator

selection.metric: Mean over the legacy, v2-incident and development-mechanism validation blocks of block score divided by the v2-selected block score; block score = mean H1/H3/H5 episode-macro normalized MAE. Ensemble prediction = mean of member predictions.
selection.rule: Lowest ensemble selection score among configurations with at least three completed seeds; ties broken by configuration name.
selection.scale_supersession: A scale-augmented configuration (settings.parent_trial) has its parent's mean forecast and supersedes the parent when it covers the same seeds.

warning.score: maximum signed constraint margin over the five forecast states, shifted by k times the predicted Laplace scale (ensemble scale = mean member scale + member disagreement)
warning.threshold_rule: smallest score threshold with at most 1 percent empirical FPR on the registered calibration episodes (unchanged v2 rule)
warning.k_rule: maximize development warning-validation recall among k with development warning-validation FPR at most validation_fpr_maximum; ties to the smaller k
warning.comparators: Every pipeline, including the v2-selected comparator, is recalibrated on the same calibration episodes; v2 pipelines use k=0.

final.historical: paper final families with duplicate-step episodes excluded and five-contiguous-transition episodes retained (v2 rule)

gates.prediction_endpoints: populations A and B x domains ferrumos and physical x H3 and H5 (8 endpoints), selected versus v2-selected
gates.primary_success_rule: All eight prediction endpoints pass (relative reduction at least 20 percent and Bonferroni-adjusted upper interval below zero) and all historical guards pass.
gates.secondary_warning_rule: For each population and domain: miss-rate reduction at least 20 percent versus the identically recalibrated v2-selected pipeline, paired recall interval lower bound above zero, and observed FPR at most 2 percent.

statistics.warning_interval: Bonferroni across four warning endpoints (two populations x two domains): paired episode-bootstrap 98.75 percent intervals
statistics.rsi_interval: paired episode-bootstrap 95 percent, exploratory and unadjusted

rsi.hypothesis: The Dream-RSI-inspired evolving-world curriculum lowers H5 error on population B relative to the uniform counterpart of the same family and seeds (one fit on the uniform development data). The arms are not compute-matched: the evolving-world arm adds mutated development worlds and refits.
rsi.claim_rule: Claim an RSI gain only if the RSI counterpart's H5 error on population B is at least 5 percent lower than the equal-family, equal-seed uniform counterpart with a paired 95 percent interval excluding zero; otherwise report no demonstrated RSI gain.
rsi.scope: Registered for FerrumOS only: the evolving-world loop refits the selected family nine times per seed; the physical autoregressive boosted family takes about 40 CPU-minutes per fit on this host, so a physical RSI arm was not run. No physical RSI claim is made.

access.verification: Regenerate catalogs from registered seeds, reload retained checkpoints, recompute inference and every statistic; never refit or reselect.

claim_boundaries: Prediction and warning gains are measured in a researcher-designed simulator; they are not real incident telemetry, controller benefit, physical safety, or permission.
Population A uses the v2 final generator; the v3 development curriculum includes regime-change mechanisms, so A is not a timing holdout for v3 models.
Population B holds out mechanism families and their motivating sources, not the simulator, labels or analysis, which remain local.
Intervals condition on the fixed selected checkpoints; retraining variability is reported separately through seed members.
Warning thresholds target 1 percent calibration FPR; shifted-population FPR is observed, not guaranteed.
archive: Boosted checkpoints are archived as prediction-only LightGBM text (training statistics and the tree_sizes index removed) in sorted JSON compressed with xz preset 9e; selection asserts bit-identical predictions against the development checkpoint before archiving.
